units: Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ bot. תשעים … מתים בפ׳ וכ׳ ninety-nine persons die through their own fault against one through the hands of heaven (a natural death); Lev. R. s. 16.—Esp. negligence in guarding a trust, indictable neglect (Ex. XXII, 8).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 94b:15">B. Mets. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>אבידה שקרובה לפ׳</he> losing which comes near to wilful neglect, opp. <cite ref="A00753"><he>אונס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 81a:16">Ib. 81ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>פ׳ בבעלים</he> a loss through carelessness that occurred in the presence of the owner (Ex. l. c. 14).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 21b">B. Kam. 21ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>תחלתו בפ׳ וסופו באונס</he> if there was neglect in the start, but the final injury came about through an unforeseen accident; a. fr.
